name: com.boxdevvvv.scenarioforge
description: Author step-by-step procedures (trainings, tutorials, linear missions, safety checklists) in an editor window, and run them with a testable, event-driven runtime.

samples.description: A complete procedure in one scene: every built-in step type, uGUI buttons raising signals, buttons enabled only during their steps, and a result screen. Uses URP materials and requires the uGUI package.
